description: This file defines the TokensRepository class which manages OAuth tokens, including creation, invalidation, refresh, and retrieval, using Prisma ORM and JWT services.

classes.name: TokensRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing OAuth tokens, including creation, invalidation, refresh, and retrieval operations.

methods.name: createAuthorizationToken
methods.description: Creates a new platform authorization token linking a client and user.

methods.name: invalidateAuthorizationToken
methods.description: Deletes an existing authorization token by its ID.

methods.name: getAuthorizationTokenByClientUserIds
methods.description: Retrieves an authorization token based on client ID and user ID.

methods.name: createOAuthTokens
methods.description: Generates new access and refresh tokens for a client and owner, with expiry times.

methods.name: forceRefreshOAuthTokens
methods.description: Deletes existing tokens and creates new ones for a client and owner.

methods.name: getAccessTokenExpiryDate
methods.description: Fetches the expiry date of an access token given its secret.

methods.name: getAccessTokenOwnerId
methods.description: Retrieves the user ID associated with an access token.

methods.name: refreshOAuthTokens
methods.description: Refreshes OAuth tokens by deleting old ones and creating new tokens.

methods.name: getAccessTokenClient
methods.description: Retrieves the client associated with a given access token.
